query:
WITH jobs_by_region AS (
  SELECT 
    employer_work_region AS region,
    COUNT(*) AS active_jobs
  FROM estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala
  WHERE is_active_job = 1
  GROUP BY employer_work_region
),
population_by_region AS (
  SELECT 
    hl.region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id) AS population
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
  JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
  WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE 
    AND hp.snapshot >= DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
  GROUP BY hl.region
)
SELECT 
  p.region,
  p.population,
  COALESCE(j.active_jobs, 0) AS active_jobs,
  CASE 
    WHEN p.population > 0 THEN COALESCE(j.active_jobs, 0) / p.population
    ELSE 0
  END AS jobs_per_capita_ratio
FROM population_by_region p
LEFT JOIN jobs_by_region j ON p.region = j.region
ORDER BY jobs_per_capita_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1000
